title: BUILDING STRATEGIES FOR GRADUATE SUCCESS
description: Provides international graduate students with cultural and academic support to supplement other content-based and language-focused courses. Emphasizes skills for graduate student success such as time management, group work, planning, professional development, and effective communication. Surveys campus resources.
registration_restrictions: Enrollment is limited to INTO OSU GE/AE/Pathways level students.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MW 1:30pm-2:50pm in ILLC 345/347 - International Living Learning 345/347 (9/23 to 12/4)
